d: A massive fire has broken out in Seoul's last shanty town. Guryong village shanty is locted next to Seoul's affluent Gangnam district. The fire at the shanty town has raged for hours, and over 100 residents have been evacuated. Firstpost also looks at protesters in Serbia who storm a pro-government newsroom studio, accusing the media of being complicit in the oppression imposed on the people by ousted president Aleksander Vucic.
